title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.28723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. translated_title: AERIN：基于视觉世界模型的空中实例导航
translated_abstract: 从高空搜索并导航至由参考图像指定的目标实例是无人机的常见应用场景。在这类任务中，高空观测为高效搜索提供了广阔的地面覆盖范围，但目标仅占据较少的像素，使得实例验证和动作选择更加困难。我们提出了AERIN，一种视觉世界模型，它利用动作条件预测来引导无人机飞向目标，同时调整其视角以获取更高质量的观测，用于后续的实例验证。高空导航需要细粒度的目标细节以及与可见性相关的场景上下文，但反复预测这些信息的密集视觉表示在计算上代价高昂。AERIN通过一个紧凑的、固定大小的目标条件潜在状态来解决这一挑战，该状态分别表示这两类信息，从而实现高效的动作评估。实验表明，AERIN优于……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出视觉世界模型AERIN，通过动作条件预测与紧凑的目标条件潜在状态表示，引导无人机高空导航至参考图像指定的目标实例，同时自适应调整视角获取高质量观测并实现高效的动作评估。
en_tdlr: AERIN is a visual world model that leverages action-conditioned prediction and a compact, fixed-size target-conditioned latent state to guide UAVs toward reference-image-specified target instances during high-altitude navigation, while adjusting viewpoints for higher-quality observations and enabling efficient action evaluation.
